text: {"faqs":[{"question":"How long do you keep my logs?","answer":"Customer application logs are kept for 13 months, while payment transaction records are retained for 7 years."},{"question":"Does Acme store my full card number?","answer":"No, Acme never stores the full card number. All card information is tokenized by the Payment Gateway to ensure security."},{"question":"What types of currencies does Acme Pay support?","answer":"Acme Pay supports transactions in USD, EUR, GBP, and INR."},{"question":"How can I reset my Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)?","answer":"MFA can be reset from the Customer Portal under Account > Security > Reset MFA. If you're locked out, support will verify your identity and send a reset link valid for 24 hours."},{"question":"What should I do if I am locked out of my account?","answer":"If you're locked out, contact support to verify your identity using two of three security factors, and they will send you a reset link."},{"question":"How long does it take to process a refund?","answer":"Refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase and are typically issued within 2 business days of approval. Please allow an additional 5-10 business days for your bank to process the refund."},{"question":"What happens to my session if I am inactive in the Customer Portal?","answer":"Sessions in the Customer Portal expire after 15 minutes of inactivity. You will receive an error message (CP-401) if this occurs."},{"question":"How does Acme Notify work?","answer":"Acme Notify provides email and SMS notifications to keep you informed about your account and transactions."},{"question":"What security measures does Acme use to protect my payment information?","answer":"Acme uses tokenization for card information, ensuring that your full card number is never stored. Additionally, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) adds an extra layer of security."},{"question":"Can I access my transaction history?","answer":"Yes, you can access your transaction history through the Acme Account Portal, where records are kept for 7 years."},{"question":"Is my personal information shared with third parties?","answer":"Acme does not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except as required by law or to provide services."},{"question":"How can I ensure my account is secure?","answer":"To ensure your account security, use strong passwords, enable Multi-Factor Authentication, and regularly monitor your account activity."},{"question":"What should I do if I notice unauthorized transactions?","answer":"If you notice unauthorized transactions, please report them immediately through the Customer Portal or contact support."},{"question":"What data does Acme collect when I use its services?","answer":"Acme collects data necessary to provide our services, which may include personal information, transaction details, and usage logs."},{"question":"How can I delete my account or personal data?","answer":"If you wish to delete your account or personal data, please contact support for assistance with the process."}]}
